dogecoin.text:
Why did Dogecoin hire Elon Musk as its CEO?

Because it wanted to reach the moon and figured he knew the fastest rocket!

Why did the Dogecoin miner bring a shovel to the computer store?

Because they heard they could dig up some virtual gold!

Why did the Dogecoin investor bring a ladder to the comedy show? 

Because they heard the Dogecoin jokes were going to the moon and wanted to get a better view!

Why did the Dogecoin investor look forward to Tuesday? 

Because it was the day they could tip with a wag and a coin on Dogecoin Tipping Tuesday!

Why did the Dogecoin investor bring a leash to the computer? 

Because they heard it was a good way to keep their digital assets on a short "leash"!

Why did the Dogecoin mascot go to obedience school? 

Because it wanted to learn how to "sit" and "stay" stable during market

Why did the Dogecoin developer go to therapy? 

Because they were feeling a bit "doge"-pressed about the fluctuating prices!

Why did the Dogecoin miner bring a shovel to work? 

Because they heard digging for coins was the best way to strike it rich in the crypto world!
